reviewRepairs: After obtaining the production lease, lstat requires mashiro.sqlite to be a regular non-symlink and its native realpath must equal the expected database path.

A separate DatabaseSync read-only probe requires the already-present user_version to equal the final expected schema before SqliteStore can open; the helper cannot perform or stand in for installer migration.
Post-write integrity_check and foreign_key_check remain inside the seed transaction so either failure rolls back all 384 rows.
boundary: PREPARED_ONLY checked the current scene, dataset, stopped process state, and existing Git revision. Revision 0b9328b does not contain schema 19 and is not execution-qualified. The helper was not run with --execute and did not open or modify the schema-18 database.
